name: Antoine Reinartz
bio: Antoine Reinartz was born in 1985 in Essey-lès-Nancy, Meurthe-et-Moselle, France. He is an actor, known for Anatomy of a Fall (2023), 120 BPM (Beats Per Minute) (2017) and Ad Vitam (2018).

credits.title: When the Night Falls
credits.overview: Follows the incredible story of a 1942 effort to to save over 100 Jewish children from a deportation camp just outside of Lyon.

credits.title: Forsaken
credits.overview: Everyone knows the name of Samuel Paty, but few people really know his story. On October 16, 2020, Samuel Paty, professor of History-Geography, was murdered at the end of his college. In the light of investigations and trials, this film looks back on his last eleven days, and the gear that led to his tragic death.

credits.title: Love Me Tender
credits.overview: At the end of summer, Clémence tells her ex-husband that she’s had relationships with women. Her life is turned upside down when he files to strip her of their son’s custody. Then begins a struggle of several years for Clémence to defend her right to be a mother and a woman – free to make her own choices.

credits.title: Anatomie d'une chute : L'ascension de Justine Triet
credits.overview: The documentary explores the Triet method by diving behind the scenes of the film Anatomy of a Fall, Palme d'Or at Cannes in 2023. Through the testimonies of Justine Triet, Arthur Harari, and the actors, it invites you into the mysteries of the making of the film, and of the director's cinema.
